response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_tallies), compared AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
